name: Rindou Aika
source:
Main character's parents pass away. He enjoys his school days together with a shrine maiden girl. Despite various obstacles, they lived happily. Until that day...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-march-2007-shirogane-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的双亲去世后，他与一名巫女女孩共同度过校园生活。尽管面临种种阻碍，两人依然幸福地生活着。直到那一天……
